title: My First Hack the North
subtitle: Hack the North 2025
paragraphs: In September, I attended Hack the North at the University of Waterloo, shortly after starting university.
I wanted to meet students working in software and engineering, especially people from universities and backgrounds different from my own.
After a summer spent mostly working independently on hardware, it was interesting to be surrounded by people building software and experimenting with new technologies over a single weekend.
Getting involved in the engineering and developer community was one of my goals for first year. Hack the North was a good introduction to the university hackathon scene, conveniently close to home.
